LESSON: THE ENLIGHTENED BEINGS

Grade: PP1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: The Enlightened Beings

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The Enlightened Beings. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name the Enlightened Beings as per the four faiths
2. recognize pictures and images of the Enlightened Beings to associate the pictures/images of themselves with the Enlightened Beings from other Enlightened Beings as per pictures as a group activity. their faith.
3. c. appreciate the Enlightened songs/stories about Paramatma Beings for divine and the Enlightened Beings knowledge. tell a short story of the Enlightened Beings listed above.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. name the Enlightened Beings as per the four faiths
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to name the Enlightened Beings as per the four faiths. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. recognize pictures and images of the Enlightened Beings to associate the pictures/images of themselves with the Enlightened Beings from other Enlightened Beings as per pictures as a group activity. their faith.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognize pictures and images of the Enlightened Beings to associate the pictures/images of themselves with the Enlightened Beings from other Enlightened Beings as per pictures as a group activity. their faith. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. c. appreciate the Enlightened songs/stories about Paramatma Beings for divine and the Enlightened Beings knowledge. tell a short story of the Enlightened Beings listed above.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to c. appreciate the Enlightened songs/stories about Paramatma Beings for divine and the Enlightened Beings knowledge. tell a short story of the Enlightened Beings listed above. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The Enlightened Beings.
2. Explain The Enlightened Beings to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Enlightened Beings.
4. Show that you can: name the Enlightened Beings as per the four faiths
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Enlightened Beings. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is The Enlightened Beings important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. name the Enlightened Beings as per the four faiths
2. recognize pictures and images of the Enlightened Beings to associate the pictures/images of themselves with the Enlightened Beings from other Enlightened Beings as per pictures as a group activity. their faith.
3. c. appreciate the Enlightened songs/stories about Paramatma Beings for divine and the Enlightened Beings knowledge. tell a short story of the Enlightened Beings listed above.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
